description: Behavioral cases for the humanize voice edit. Two of these are false-positive cases: they fail if the skill over-corrects a deliberate choice. Those matter most, because over-correction is the failure mode the skill was rewritten to prevent.

evals.prompt: Humanize this: "The approach is more specific. More actionable. Closer to the real problem."
evals.expected_output: The three fragments merge into one sentence. All three qualities survive.

assertions.name: fragments-merged
assertions.check: The three fragments are joined into a single sentence rather than left as three standalone fragments

assertions.name: meaning-preserved
assertions.check: All three qualities (more specific, more actionable, closer to the real problem) are still present

evals.prompt: Humanize this paragraph: "I have a 327-name scored lead tracker for my product. Behind it sits a CRM with 41 notes and a 16-status funnel, every stage defined. Eight blog posts are finished. Three emails sent. One reply. Zero closes."
evals.expected_output: The closing three-beat sequence stays as three sentences. It lands a build-up, so merging it destroys the punch.

assertions.name: landing-fragment-preserved
assertions.check: 'Three emails sent. One reply. Zero closes.' remains as three separate sentences (or the equivalent short landing beat)

assertions.name: no-merger
assertions.check: The three closing beats are NOT merged into one comma-joined sentence

assertions.name: numbers-preserved
assertions.check: 327, 41, 16, and eight all survive unchanged

evals.prompt: Humanize this: "The build finished in 40 minutes. The team shipped it the same day."
evals.expected_output: The sentences stay committed. No hedge is added to either.

assertions.name: no-hedge-added
assertions.check: No hedge word or phrase is introduced - none of: so far, with any certainty, about, roughly, may, might, could, perhaps, seems, appears, tends

assertions.name: no-not-only-butt
assertions.check: The phrase 'not only' does not appear anywhere in the output

assertions.name: certainty-preserved
assertions.check: 'The build finished in 40 minutes' remains a plain assertion rather than being softened or reworded to imply uncertainty

evals.prompt: Humanize this: "Startup is about 12% faster so far, though we have only tested Pixel 8."
evals.expected_output: The existing hedges and the scope limit survive intact. Nothing is added.

assertions.name: existing-hedges-preserved
assertions.check: 'so far' and the approximate force of 'about 12%' both survive

assertions.name: scope-preserved
assertions.check: The Pixel 8 limitation is retained

assertions.name: no-hedge-added
assertions.check: No additional hedge is inserted beyond the ones already in the source

evals.prompt: Humanize this: "What you lose when you defer: auditability."
evals.expected_output: The single-noun colon reveal becomes a phrase containing a verb.

assertions.name: colon-reveal-expanded
assertions.check: The abstract noun is expanded into a phrase that includes a verb, e.g. 'your ability to audit the work'

assertions.name: no-bare-single-noun-reveal
assertions.check: The output does not end a clause on a single abstract noun after a colon

evals.prompt: Humanize this: "The model — to its credit — usually finds a path. The fix — and this matters — is composable systems."
evals.expected_output: Every em-dash is gone. No comma-heavy stutter replaces them.

assertions.name: no-em-dash-remains
assertions.check: Neither the em-dash character nor an en-dash used as punctuation appears anywhere in the output

assertions.name: meaning-preserved
assertions.check: Both the 'to its credit' aside and the 'this matters' emphasis survive in some form

evals.prompt: Humanize this: "The spec defines the work; the agent executes against it."
evals.expected_output: The semicolon becomes a period and a new sentence.

assertions.name: semicolon-removed
assertions.check: No semicolon joins two independent clauses in the output

assertions.name: both-clauses-survive
assertions.check: Both the spec clause and the agent clause are still present

evals.prompt: Humanize this: "The launch had some problems. Users complained and the team fixed things fast. This taught us to prepare better."
evals.expected_output: Either the passage stays plain, or the missing specifics are marked as open questions. No detail is invented, and the motivational close is not preserved as-is.

assertions.name: no-invented-specifics
assertions.check: No incident, outage, user count, date, quotation, metric, or named person is added that was not in the source

assertions.name: gap-marked-or-plain
assertions.check: The output either keeps the account plain or leaves an explicit [TK: ...] question requesting the missing detail

assertions.name: no-sanitized-lesson-close
assertions.check: The closing 'This taught us to prepare better' is not left as a generic motivational summary

evals.prompt: Humanize this: "I got quite good at prompting. The problem was somewhere I hadn't looked yet."
evals.expected_output: The first-person confessional register survives untouched.

assertions.name: confessional-preserved
assertions.check: 'I got quite good at prompting' is not rewritten into resume language such as 'I became skilled at'

assertions.name: first-person-kept
assertions.check: Neither first-person claim is converted to passive or impersonal construction

evals.prompt: Humanize this: "In today's fast-moving AI landscape, prompt engineering has become a critical skill that developers must master."
evals.expected_output: Prose is improved and no detector result is asserted.

assertions.name: no-detector-claim
assertions.check: The response does not claim the text will pass, evade, or score on an AI detector, and does not present a detector score as evidence of quality

assertions.name: throat-clearing-removed
assertions.check: The 'In today's fast-moving AI landscape' opener is removed or replaced with something concrete

evals.prompt: Humanize this for an X post: "261 skills were sitting in my system prompt. 187,801 characters of names and descriptions, on every request."
evals.expected_output: Implementation vocabulary is replaced with the reader's vocabulary on a social surface: 'system prompt' becomes 'configuration', and 'prompt' becomes 'context'.

assertions.name: implementation-vocabulary-swapped
assertions.check: On a social or short-form surface, 'system prompt' becomes 'configuration' and 'prompt' becomes 'context'

assertions.name: not-a-brevity-edit
assertions.check: The substitution is not driven by length: 'configuration' is the same character count as 'system prompt'

assertions.name: technical-surface-preserved
assertions.check: The same implementation terms are kept when the surface is technical documentation rather than social

evals.prompt: Humanize this: "Sharp edge if you try it: skills Pi loads from directories you haven't listed leave the prompt and don't enter search."
evals.expected_output: The coined label plus colon becomes a plain imperative, and 'the prompt' becomes 'your config'.

assertions.name: coined-label-replaced-by-imperative
assertions.check: 'Sharp edge if you try it:' becomes a plain imperative such as 'Beware if you try it.'

assertions.name: no-label-plus-colon
assertions.check: The output does not open a caveat by coining a label and following that label with a colon

assertions.name: possessive-second-person
assertions.check: The warning addresses the reader directly, as in 'your config' rather than 'the prompt'

evals.prompt: Humanize this paragraph: "I have a 327-name scored lead tracker for my product. Additionally, behind it sits a robust CRM with 41 notes and a 16-status funnel, every stage defined. Eight blog posts are finished. Three emails sent. One reply. Zero closes."
evals.expected_output: "Additionally" and "robust" are removed. The landing beat survives even though it trips Rule of Three, and is reported as a kept deduction. The return carries a score, the deductions, and before → after changed lines.

assertions.name: banned-words-removed
assertions.check: Neither 'Additionally' nor 'robust' appears in the final draft

assertions.name: landing-beat-kept
assertions.check: 'Three emails sent. One reply. Zero closes.' remains as three separate sentences

assertions.name: kept-deduction-reported
assertions.check: If the landing beat is penalised, it appears under Deductions as a kept item with a reason, not rewritten

assertions.name: score-reported
assertions.check: The return states a numeric final score

assertions.name: changed-lines-listed
assertions.check: The return lists every changed line in before → after form

assertions.name: numbers-preserved
assertions.check: 327, 41, 16, and eight all survive unchanged

evals.prompt: Write a short email to Dana confirming we should move our sync. Additionally note the deck is ready. Ask whether Tuesday at 2pm works.
evals.expected_output: The email asks whether Tuesday at 2pm works. Any pattern-19 deduction on that ask is reported as kept, not rewritten away.

assertions.name: ask-survives
assertions.check: The final email still asks Dana whether Tuesday at 2pm works

assertions.name: ask-kept-not-cut
assertions.check: If the ask is penalised under pattern 19, it is listed under Deductions as a kept item with a reason

assertions.name: no-banned-additionally
assertions.check: 'Additionally' does not appear in the final email

assertions.name: score-reported
assertions.check: The return states a numeric final score and lists changed lines as before → after
